master.prompt: Correct this master. Keep its 5 road axles in same grouped arrangement, but all road tires MUST be EXACTLY identical in diameter. Enlarge trailer tires to match tractor tires, same circular rims centered at same horizontal hub height, same level tire bottoms. blocky all-terrain with sipes. Ensure real scale: whole rig including load at most 16.8m, tire diameter 2.03m; rig length max 8.28 tire diameters. Shorten deck gaps and load proportionately as necessary to meet this ratio, with heavy load supported by wheel groups. Place entire object within central 85% of canvas with generous transparent margins, especially mast tips. Remove ALL colored edge fringe, red/green/yellow halos and stray pixels around and within silhouette. Clean neutral alpha edges. Keep design, load, cab, chains and weathered painted style. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. No cab front face. True transparent background, no text, shadow or ground.

True transparent background with clean alpha edges, no colored fringe.

True transparent background. No body, axle, ground, shadow, text, logo or colored halo.

Swamp Scout premium semi-realistic painted illustration, dark contours, rich weathered materials, grime, fine mechanical details.
